exercises.instructionEn: Present Simple - Form. Affirmative: I work, he works. Negative: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. Interrogative: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon - Shakli. Tasdiq: I work, he works. Inkor: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. So'roq: Do I work? Does he work?
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  WORK
  he / she / it        WORKS

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda -S / -ES.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I / you / we / they  DON'T work
  he / she / it        DOESN'T work

  ⚠ Uzun: do not / does not.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin fe'lda -S
  YO'Q: 'he doesn't work' ('works'
  emas!).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DO I / you / we / they work?
  DOES he / she / it work?

  ⚠ 'Does he like tennis?' - 'likes'
  emas!


⚠ 'A SUBJECT':

  = ega.


⚠ 'THIRD PERSON SINGULAR':

  = 3-shaxs birlik (he, she, it).


⚠ 'THE MAIN VERB':

  = asosiy fe'l.

tasks.en: Present Simple - Form. Affirmative: I work, he works. Negative: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. Interrogative: Do I work? Does he work?
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamon - Shakli. Tasdiq: I work, he works. Inkor: I do not (don't) work, he does not (doesn't) work. So'roq: Do I work? Does he work?

tasks.en: We form the present simple with the subject (noun or personal pronoun) and the verb. The third person singular takes -s or -es in the affirmative.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni ega (ot yoki kishilik olmoshi) va fe'l bilan yasaymiz. Tasdiqda 3-shaxs birlik -s yoki -es oladi.

tasks.en: Negative: We use subject + don't + main verb in all persons except the third person singular. We use subject + doesn't + main verb in this person. I don't play, he doesn't play.
tasks.uz: Inkor: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda ega + don't + asosiy fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda ega + doesn't + asosiy fe'l. I don't play, he doesn't play.

tasks.en: Interrogative: We use do + subject + verb in all persons except for the third person singular. We use does + subject + verb in this person. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?
tasks.uz: So'roq: 3-shaxs birlikdan tashqari barcha shaxslarda do + ega + fe'l. 3-shaxs birlikda does + ega + fe'l. Do you like football? Does he like tennis?

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling: 3rd person singular affirmative.
exercises.instructionUz: Imlo: 3-shaxs birlik tasdiq.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK IMLOSI:

  1 Ko'p fe'llar → -S:
    work → works
  2 -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan
    tugasa → -ES:
    go → goes, watch → watches,
    kiss → kisses, wash → washes,
    fix → fixes
  3 undosh + y → -y tushib -IES:
    fly → flies, study → studies
  4 unli + y → -S:
    play → plays, buy → buys


⚠ 'A CONSONANT':

  = undosh harf.


⚠ 'A VOWEL':

  = unli harf (a, e, i, o, u).

tasks.en: Spelling: 3rd person singular affirmative.
tasks.uz: Imlo: 3-shaxs birlik tasdiq.

tasks.en: Most verbs take -s in the third person singular. I work - he works
tasks.uz: Ko'p fe'llar 3-shaxs birlikda -s oladi. I work - he works

tasks.en: Verbs ending in -ss, -sh, -ch, -x or -o take -es. I go - he goes
tasks.uz: -ss, -sh, -ch, -x yoki -o bilan tugagan fe'llar -es oladi. I go - he goes

tasks.en: Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop -y and take -ies. I fly - he flies
tasks.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -y ni tashlab -ies oladi. I fly - he flies

tasks.en: Verbs ending in a vowel + y take -s. I play - he plays
tasks.uz: Unli + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -s oladi. I play - he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular.
exercises.instructionUz: Talaffuz: 3-shaxs birlikda -s yoki -es.
exercises.explanationUz:
-S / -ES TALAFFUZI:

  /s/ - jarangsiz undoshdan keyin
    (/f/, /k/, /p/, /t/):
    sits /sɪts/, works /wɜːks/,
    laughs /lɑːfs/, stops /stɒps/

  /ɪz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan
    keyin (/s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/,
    /z/):
    watches /ˈwɒtʃɪz/, washes,
    kisses, changes, uses

  /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlardan
    keyin (jarangli undosh, unli):
    plays /pleɪz/, goes /ɡəʊz/,
    runs /rʌnz/, lives /lɪvz/


⚠ Bu qoida OTLARNING KO'PLIGIGA
ham tegishli: cats /s/, dogs /z/,
buses /ɪz/.

tasks.en: Pronunciation: -s or -es in the third person singular.
tasks.uz: Talaffuz: 3-shaxs birlikda -s yoki -es.

tasks.en: /s/ with verbs ending in /f/, /k/, /p/ or /t/ sounds. he sits
tasks.uz: /s/ - /f/, /k/, /p/ yoki /t/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he sits

tasks.en: /ɪz/ with verbs ending in /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ or /z/ sounds. he watches
tasks.uz: /ɪz/ - /s/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ yoki /z/ tovushlari bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he watches

tasks.en: /z/ with verbs ending in all other sounds. he plays
tasks.uz: /z/ - boshqa barcha tovushlar bilan tugagan fe'llarda. he plays

exercises.instructionEn: Use. We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits, and permanent states. Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik odatlar, takrorlanuvchi ishlar va doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Vaqt iboralari: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - IShLATILIShI:

  1 KUNDALIK ODATLAR, takrorlanuvchi
    ishlar:
    'I GET UP at seven every day.'
  2 DOIMIY HOLATLAR:
    'I LIVE in London.'


VAQT IBORALARI:

  every hour/day/week/month/
    summer/year = har soat/kun/
    hafta/oy/yoz/yil
  usually = odatda
  always = har doim
  every morning/evening = har
    ertalab/kechqurun
  in the morning/afternoon/evening
    = ertalab/tushdan keyin/
    kechqurun
  at night = kechasi

  ⚠ 'IN the morning' lekin 'AT
  night'!


QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Do you ...? → Yes, I do. / No,
    I don't.
  Does he/she/it ...? → Yes, he
    does. / No, he doesn't.
  Do they ...? → Yes, they do. /
    No, they don't.

  ⚠ Qisqa javobda ASOSIY FE'L
  takrorlanmaydi: 'Yes, I do' ('Yes,
  I like' EMAS).


⚠ 'A ROUTINE':

  = kundalik tartib.


⚠ 'A HABIT':

  = odat.


⚠ 'PERMANENT':

  = doimiy.

tasks.en: Use. We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits, and permanent states. Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
tasks.uz: Ishlatilishi. Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik odatlar, takrorlanuvchi ishlar va doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Vaqt iboralari: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

tasks.en: We use the present simple for daily routines, repeated actions or habits. I get up at seven every day.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni kundalik tartib, takrorlanuvchi ishlar yoki odatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men har kuni yettida turaman.

tasks.en: We use the present simple for permanent states. I live in London.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi oddiy zamonni doimiy holatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Men Londonda yashayman.

tasks.en: Time expressions: every hour/day/week/month/summer/year etc, usually, always, every morning/evening/afternoon/night, in the morning/afternoon/evening/night, at night etc.
tasks.uz: Vaqt iboralari: har soat/kun/hafta/oy/yoz/yil, odatda, har doim, har ertalab/kechqurun/tushdan keyin/kecha, ertalab/tushdan keyin/kechqurun, kechasi.

tasks.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and do/don't or does/doesn't. Do you ...? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't. Does he ...? - Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va do/don't yoki does/doesn't ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing). Affirmative: I'm playing, he's playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Is he playing? Negative: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi davomli zamon (to be + fe'l -ing). Tasdiq: I'm playing, he's playing. So'roq: Am I playing? Is he playing? Inkor: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ShAKLI.

  BE (am/is/are) + FE'L-ING


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm playing
  you're / we're / they're playing
  he's / she's / it's playing


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Am I playing?
  Are you / we / they playing?
  Is he / she / it playing?

  ⚠ 'be' oldinga chiqadi.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I'm not playing
  you aren't / we aren't playing
  he isn't / she isn't playing


⚠ 'THE BASE FORM':

  = fe'lning asosiy shakli (play,
  go).

tasks.en: Present Continuous (to be + verb -ing). Affirmative: I'm playing, he's playing. Interrogative: Am I playing? Is he playing? Negative: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamon (to be + fe'l -ing). Tasdiq: I'm playing, he's playing. So'roq: Am I playing? Is he playing? Inkor: I'm not playing, he isn't playing. Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.

tasks.en: Affirmative: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.
tasks.uz: Tasdiq: I'm playing, you're playing, he's/she's/it's playing, we're/they're playing.

tasks.en: Interrogative: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?
tasks.uz: So'roq: Am I playing? Are you playing? Is he/she/it playing? Are we/they playing?

tasks.en: Negative: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.
tasks.uz: Inkor: I'm not playing, you aren't playing, he/she/it isn't playing, we/they aren't playing.

tasks.en: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamonni 'to be' fe'li va asosiy fe'lning asosiy shakliga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Use. Time expressions: now, at the moment, at present. Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: now, at the moment, at present. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - IShLATILIShI:

  1 HOZIR, gapirish paytida
    bo'layotgan ish:
    "I'm playing tennis NOW."
  2 Gapirish vaqti ATROFIDA
    bo'layotgan ish (aynan hozir
    emas):
    "We're looking for a flat at the
     moment."
  3 YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI ANIQ REJA:
    "I'm seeing John tomorrow."


VAQT IBORALARI:
  now = hozir
  at the moment = ayni paytda
  at present = hozirda


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Are you ...? → Yes, I am. / No,
    I'm not.
  Is he ...? → Yes, he is. / No, he
    isn't.
  Are they ...? → Yes, they are. /
    No, they aren't.

  ⚠ -ING fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'Yes,
  I am' ('Yes, I am playing' EMAS).
  ⚠ 'Yes, I'm' - XATO! Qisqa
  ijobiy javobda qisqartma yo'q.


⚠ 'A FIXED ARRANGEMENT':

  = aniq kelishilgan reja.


⚠ 'A FLAT':

  = kvartira (BrE).

tasks.en: Use. Time expressions: now, at the moment, at present. Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
tasks.uz: Ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: now, at the moment, at present. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.

tasks.en: Actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. I'm playing tennis now.
tasks.uz: Hozir, gapirish paytida bo'layotgan ishlar. Men hozir tennis o'ynayapman.

tasks.en: Actions happening around the time of speaking. We're looking for a flat at the moment.
tasks.uz: Gapirish vaqti atrofida bo'layotgan ishlar. Biz ayni paytda kvartira qidiryapmiz.

tasks.en: Fixed arrangements in the near future. I'm seeing John tomorrow.
tasks.uz: Yaqin kelajakdagi aniq rejalar. Men ertaga John bilan uchrashaman.

tasks.en: In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.
tasks.uz: Qisqa javoblarda 'Yes' yoki 'No', ega olmoshi va 'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shaklini ishlatamiz. -ing li asosiy fe'lni takrorlamaymiz.

sections.title: Unit 2 - Adverbs of Frequency; Past Simple

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually - asosiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI:

  always = har doim (100%)
  usually = odatda
  often = tez-tez
  sometimes = ba'zan
  rarely = kamdan-kam (= not often)
  never = hech qachon (0%)


O'RNI:

  1 ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
    'I NEVER get up early.'
    'He RARELY goes to the zoo.'
    'She SOMETIMES has a sandwich.'
  2 YoRDAMChI FE'LDAN KEYIN:
    'Do you OFTEN walk to work?'
  3 'BE' DAN KEYIN:
    'Mum IS USUALLY home by four.'
    'He IS ALWAYS late for work.'

  ⚠ 'He always is late' - XATO!
  ⚠ 'never' bilan inkor
  ishlatilmaydi: "I don't never" ✗.


⚠ 'AN AUXILIARY VERB':

  = yordamchi fe'l (do, does, did,
  have, will ...).

tasks.en: Adverbs of frequency, always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually come before the main verb, but after the auxiliary verb (do, does etc) and the verb to be. They tell us how often something happens.
tasks.uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari - always, often, never, rarely, sometimes, usually - asosiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin yordamchi fe'l (do, does va h.k.) va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin keladi. Ular biror narsa qanchalik tez-tez bo'lishini bildiradi.

tasks.en: Adverbs of frequency come before the main verb: I never get up early on Sundays. He rarely goes to the zoo. (= not often) She sometimes has a sandwich for lunch.
tasks.uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan oldin keladi: Men yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman. U kamdan-kam hayvonot bog'iga boradi. U ba'zan tushlikka sendvich yeydi.

tasks.en: But after the auxiliary verb: Do you often walk to work?
tasks.uz: Lekin yordamchi fe'ldan keyin: Siz tez-tez ishga piyoda borasizmi?

tasks.en: And after the verb to be: Mum is usually home by four. He is always late for work.
tasks.uz: Va 'to be' fe'lidan keyin: Onam odatda to'rtgacha uyda bo'ladi. U har doim ishga kech qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Simple: regular verbs. Affirmative: I worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Negative: I didn't work.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan oddiy zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar. Tasdiq: I worked. So'roq: Did I work? Inkor: I didn't work.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE - ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TASDIQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  To'g'ri fe'llar: FE'L + -ED
    work → worked (HAMMA shaxsda
    bir xil!)
  Noto'g'ri fe'llar: 2-shakl
    see → saw, go → went
    (ro'yxat 128-betda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DIDN'T + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'I didn't WORK yesterday.'
  'I didn't SEE Tom.' ('didn't saw'
   EMAS!)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO'ROQ                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  DID + EGA + ASOSIY ShAKL
  'Did he WORK yesterday?'
  'Did you SEE Tom?' ('Did you saw'
   EMAS!)


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did you call me? → Yes, I DID.
  Did he tell you? → No, he DIDN'T.


⚠ 'REGULAR' / 'IRREGULAR':

  = to'g'ri / noto'g'ri (fe'l).

tasks.en: Past Simple: regular verbs. Affirmative: I worked. Interrogative: Did I work? Negative: I didn't work.
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar. Tasdiq: I worked. So'roq: Did I work? Inkor: I didn't work.

tasks.en: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked. Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw (see list of irregular verbs on p. 128)
tasks.uz: Ko'p to'g'ri fe'llarning tasdiq shaklini fe'lga -ed qo'shib yasaymiz. I work - I worked. Boshqa fe'llar noto'g'ri tasdiq shakliga ega. I see - I saw (noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati 128-betda)

tasks.en: We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday, I didn't see Tom yesterday.
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon inkorini didn't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. Kecha ishlamadim, kecha Tomni ko'rmadim.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative of past simple with Did + personal subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamon so'rog'ini Did + ega olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U kecha ishladimi? Kecha Tomni ko'rdingizmi?

tasks.en: We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.
tasks.uz: Ijobiy qisqa javoblarni did, inkor qisqa javoblarni didn't bilan yasaymiz. Menga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi? Ha. U senga aytdimi? Yo'q.

sections.title: Unit 2 - Past Simple (Spelling, Use); Used to
sections.titleUz: 2-unit - O'tgan oddiy zamon (imlo, ishlatilishi); Used to

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling of -ed. Use of the past simple. Time expressions: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
exercises.instructionUz: -ed imlosi. O'tgan oddiy zamon ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
-ED IMLOSI:

  1 -e bilan tugasa → faqat -D:
    live → lived, dance → danced
  2 undosh + y → -y tushib -IED:
    try → tried, study → studied
  3 bitta urg'uli unli + undosh →
    undosh IKKILANADI + -ed:
    stop → stopped, plan → planned


PAST SIMPLE - IShLATILIShI:

  1 O'tmishda bo'lgan va yana
    takrorlanmaydigan ishlar:
    'He GRADUATED in 1998.'
  2 O'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA bo'lgan
    ishlar:
    'He VISITED his grandparents
     last Sunday.'


VAQT IBORALARI:
  yesterday = kecha
  last night/morning/evening/week
    = o'tgan kecha/ertalab/kechqurun/
    hafta
  two weeks ago = ikki hafta oldin
  a month ago = bir oy oldin
  in 1964 = 1964 yilda

  ⚠ 'ago' - muddatdan KEYIN
  keladi.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did you work? → Yes, I did. / No,
    I didn't.


⚠ 'TO GRADUATE':

  = bitirmoq (o'quv yurtini).


⚠ 'HIGH SCHOOL':

  = o'rta maktab (yuqori sinflar).


⚠ 'SPECIFIC':

  = aniq, muayyan.

tasks.en: Spelling of -ed. Use of the past simple. Time expressions: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
tasks.uz: -ed imlosi. O'tgan oddiy zamon ishlatilishi. Vaqt iboralari: yesterday, last night/morning/evening, two weeks/a month ago, in 1964. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

tasks.en: We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I live - I lived
tasks.uz: -e bilan tugagan fe'llarga -d qo'shamiz. I live - I lived

tasks.en: Verbs ending in consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I try - I tried
tasks.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'llar -y ni tashlab -ied qo'shadi. I try - I tried

tasks.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ed. I stop - I stopped
tasks.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bo'lgan fe'llar oxirgi undoshni ikkilantirib -ed oladi. I stop - I stopped

tasks.en: We use the past simple for actions which happened in the past and won't happen again. He graduated from high school in 1998. We also use it for actions which happened at a specific time in the past. He visited his grandparents last Sunday.

exercises.instructionEn: Order of Adjectives. Adjectives describe nouns. They go before nouns. They have the same form in the singular and plural. Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. Fact adjectives order: size, weight, shape, colour, material. It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.

SIFATLAR TARTIBI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ASOSIY QOIDALAR                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 Sifat OTDAN OLDIN: 'a blue car'
  2 Ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI: 'two
    blue cars' ('blues' EMAS!)
  3 FIKR sifati FAKT sifatidan
    oldin: 'an EXPENSIVE long dress'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FAKT SIFATLARI TARTIBI          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 O'LChAM (size): small, big,
    short, long
  2 OG'IRLIK (weight): heavy, light
  3 ShAKL (shape): triangular,
    round, rectangular, square
  4 RANG (colour): dark/light blue,
    yellow, pink, cream, red, purple
  5 MATERIAL: cotton, leather, silk,
    plastic, woollen, nylon, metal,
    gold, silver, velvet, wooden,
    canvas

  MISOL:
  'an EXPENSIVE (fikr), SHORT
   (o'lcham), BLACK (rang), LEATHER
   (material) jacket'


⚠ FIKR SIFATLARI:

  beautiful, great, expensive,
  nice, lovely, awful ...
  = biz nima deb O'YLAYMIZ.


⚠ FAKT SIFATLARI:

  short, long, red ...
  = HAQIQATAN qanday.


⚠ MATERIALLAR:

  cotton = paxta; leather = teri;
  silk = ipak; woollen = jun;
  velvet = baxmal; wooden = yog'och;
  canvas = brezent.


⚠ ShAKLLAR:

  triangular = uchburchak; round =
  dumaloq; rectangular =
  to'rtburchak; square = kvadrat.

tasks.en: There are two types of adjectives: Opinion adjectives (beautiful, great, expensive etc) which show what we think of someone or something and fact adjectives (short, long, red etc) which show what someone or something really is. Opinion adjectives go before fact adjectives. She's wearing an expensive long dress.
tasks.uz: Ikki xil sifat bor: fikr sifatlari (chiroyli, ajoyib, qimmat) - biz kimdir yoki nimadir haqida nima deb o'ylashimizni ko'rsatadi; fakt sifatlari (kalta, uzun, qizil) - haqiqatan qanday ekanini ko'rsatadi. Fikr sifatlari fakt sifatlaridan oldin keladi. U qimmat uzun ko'ylak kiygan.

tasks.en: When there are two or more fact adjectives, they go in this order: size, weight, shape, colour, material. It's an expensive, short, black, leather jacket.
tasks.uz: Ikki yoki undan ko'p fakt sifati bo'lsa, tartib: o'lcham, og'irlik, shakl, rang, material. Bu qimmat, kalta, qora, teri kurtka.

One-syllable adjectives: cheap - cheaper - the cheapest; large - larger - the largest; big - bigger - the biggest. -y adjectives: noisy - noisier - the noisiest. Adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive - more expensive - the most expensive. QIYoSIY va ORTTIRMA DARAJA.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  BIR BO'G'INLI: -ER / -EST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  cheap → cheapER → the cheapEST
  large → largER → the largEST
    (-e bilan tugasa faqat -r/-st)
  big → biGGer → the biGGest
    (unli + undosh → ikkilanadi)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  -Y SIFATLAR: -IER / -IEST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  noisy → noisIER → the noisIEST
  happy → happier → the happiest


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  2+ BO'G'INLI: MORE / MOST       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  expensive → MORE expensive →
    the MOST expensive
  ⚠ 'expensiver' - XATO!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NOTO'G'RI                       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  good → better → the best
  bad → worse → the worst
  much/many → more → the most
  little → less → the least

  'the cheapest', 'the best'.


⚠ QIYoSLASh QOLIPI:

  X is cheapER THAN Y.
  X is the cheapEST (in/of ...).


⚠ 'A SYLLABLE':

  = bo'g'in.

exercises.instructionEn: Form and spelling of comparatives and superlatives.
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarning shakli va imlosi.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYoSLASh - ShAKLI:

  1 BIR BO'G'INLI → -(e)r / -(e)st:
    cheap - cheaper - the cheapest
    large - larger - the largest
  2 IKKI BO'G'INLI -ly, -y, -w →
    -er / -est:
    heavy - heavier - the heaviest
    narrow - narrower - the
    narrowest
  3 IKKI+ BO'G'INLI → more / most:
    expensive - more expensive -
    the most expensive
  4 SIFAT bilan bir xil RAVIShLAR →
    -er / -est:
    fast - faster - the fastest
  5 -LY RAVIShLAR → more / most:
    quickly - more quickly - the
    most quickly


IMLO:
  unli + undosh → IKKILANADI:
    fat - faTTer - the faTTest
    big - bigger, hot - hotter
  undosh + y → -IER / -IEST:
    noisy - noisier - the noisiest


⚠ 'THAN' / 'OF' / 'IN':

  cheaper THAN = ...dan arzonroq
  the cheapest OF all / IN the
  shop = hammasidan / do'kondagi
  eng arzon


⚠ 'COMPOUND':

  = qo'shma.

tasks.en: Form and spelling of comparatives and superlatives.
tasks.uz: Qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarning shakli va imlosi.

tasks.en: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st. cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in), large - larger - the largest
tasks.uz: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar -(e)r/-(e)st qo'shadi. cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in), large - larger - the largest

tasks.en: Two-syllable adjectives ending in -ly, -y, -w also add -er/-est. heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)
tasks.uz: -ly, -y, -w bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar ham -er/-est qo'shadi. heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)

tasks.en: Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most. expensive - more expensive (than) - the most expensive (of/in)
tasks.uz: Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar more/most oladi. expensive - more expensive (than) - the most expensive (of/in)

tasks.en: Adverbs having the same form as their adjectives add -er/-est. fast - faster - the fastest. Two-syllable or compound adverbs take more/most. quickly - more quickly - the most quickly
tasks.uz: Sifati bilan bir xil shakldagi ravishlar -er/-est qo'shadi. fast - faster - the fastest. Ikki bo'g'inli yoki qo'shma ravishlar more/most oladi. quickly - more quickly - the most quickly

tasks.en: Spelling: One-syllable adjectives ending in a vowel + a consonant double the consonant. fat - fatter - the fattest. Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + y replace -y with -ie. noisy - noisier - the noisiest
tasks.uz: Imlo: unli + undosh bilan tugagan bir bo'g'inli sifatlar undoshni ikkilantiradi. fat - fatter - the fattest. Undosh + y bilan tugagan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar -y ni -ie ga almashtiradi. noisy - noisier - the noisiest

exercises.instructionEn: Use of comparatives and superlatives. (not) as + adjective + as. much + comparative.
exercises.instructionUz: Qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarning ishlatilishi. (not) as + sifat + as. much + qiyosiy daraja.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYoSLASh - IShLATILIShI:

  1 QIYoSIY DARAJA - IKKI narsani
    solishtirish, 'THAN' bilan:
    'The city is noisier THAN the
     country.'

  2 ORTTIRMA DARAJA - bittasini
    GURUH bilan solishtirish, 'THE
    ... OF/IN' bilan:
    'The giraffe is THE tallest
     animal OF all.'
    'He is THE shortest student IN
     the class.'

  3 (NOT) AS ... AS - bir xil / bir
    xil emas:
    'My brother is AS tall AS my
     father.' (bir xil bo'y)
    'He is NOT AS tall AS me.'
    (pastroq)

  4 MUCH + QIYoSIY - katta farq:
    'An elephant is MUCH heavier
     than a mouse.'
    ⚠ 'very heavier' - XATO!


⚠ 'SIMILAR':

  = o'xshash.


⚠ 'THE COUNTRY':

  bu yerda = qishloq joyi (shahar
  emas).

tasks.en: Use of comparatives and superlatives. (not) as + adjective + as. much + comparative.
tasks.uz: Qiyosiy va orttirma darajalarning ishlatilishi. (not) as + sifat + as. much + qiyosiy daraja.

tasks.en: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives. The city is noisier than the country.
tasks.uz: Qiyosiy darajani ikki odam, narsa, joyni solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Qiyosiy sifatlar bilan odatda 'than' ishlatamiz. Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.

tasks.en: We use the superlative form to compare one person or thing with more than one person or thing in the same group. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives. The giraffe is the tallest animal of all. He is the shortest student in the class.
tasks.uz: Orttirma darajani bir odam yoki narsani bir guruhdagi ko'pchilik bilan solishtirish uchun ishlatamiz. Orttirma sifatlar bilan 'the ... of/in' ishlatamiz. Jirafa hammasidan eng baland hayvon. U sinfdagi eng past bo'yli o'quvchi.

tasks.en: We can also use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, places or things are/are not similar. My brother is as tall as my father.
tasks.uz: Ikki odam, joy yoki narsa o'xshash/o'xshash emasligini aytish uchun (not) as + sifat + as ham ishlatishimiz mumkin. Akam otam bilan bir xil bo'yda.

tasks.en: We use much + comparative form. An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.
tasks.uz: Much + qiyosiy daraja ishlatamiz. Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Continuous. We form the past continuous with was/were and add -ing to the base form of the main verb. Affirmative: I was eating. Negative: I wasn't eating. Interrogative: Was I eating? Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan davomli zamon. O'tgan davomli zamonni was/were va asosiy fe'lga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz. Tasdiq: I was eating. Inkor: I wasn't eating. So'roq: Was I eating? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST CONTINUOUS - ShAKLI.

  WAS / WERE + FE'L-ING

  TASDIQ: I/he/she/it WAS eating;
    you/we/they WERE eating
  INKOR: wasn't / weren't eating
  SO'ROQ: Was I eating? Were you
    eating?
  QISQA: Yes, I was. / No, I
    wasn't. Yes, they were. / No,
    they weren't.


PAST CONTINUOUS - IShLATILIShI:

  1 O'tmishda BIR VAQTDA bo'lgan
    ikki+ ish ('while'):
    'John WAS CUTTING the grass
     WHILE Jenny WAS PLANTING
     flowers.'

  2 DAVOM ETAYoTGAN ish UZILGANDA
    ('when'):
    uzun ish → past continuous
    qisqa ish → past simple
    'She WAS HAVING a bath WHEN the
     phone RANG.'

  3 O'tmishdagi ANIQ VAQTDA davom
    etayotgan ish:
    'James WAS SLEEPING at 9
     o'clock last night.'

  4 Hikoyada FON ma'lumoti:
    'The wind WAS BLOWING when Jane
     left work.'


⚠ 'WHILE' va 'WHEN':

  while + past continuous
  when + past simple


⚠ 'IN PROGRESS':

  = davom etayotgan.


⚠ 'TO INTERRUPT':

  = uzmoq, to'xtatmoq.


⚠ 'BACKGROUND':

  = fon.

tasks.en: Past Continuous. We form the past continuous with was/were and add -ing to the base form of the main verb. Affirmative: I was eating. Negative: I wasn't eating. Interrogative: Was I eating? Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
tasks.uz: O'tgan davomli zamon. O'tgan davomli zamonni was/were va asosiy fe'lga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz. Tasdiq: I was eating. Inkor: I wasn't eating. So'roq: Was I eating? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

tasks.en: We form the past continuous with was/were (past tense of the verb "to be") and add -ing to the base form of the main verb. I was eating, you were eating. I wasn't eating. Was I eating? Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
tasks.uz: O'tgan davomli zamonni was/were ('to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) va asosiy fe'lga -ing qo'shib yasaymiz. I was eating, you were eating. I wasn't eating. Was I eating? Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.

tasks.en: Two or more actions happening at the same time in the past. John was cutting the grass while Jenny was planting flowers.
tasks.uz: O'tmishda bir vaqtda bo'lgan ikki yoki undan ko'p ish. John o't o'rayotganda Jenny gul ekayotgan edi.

tasks.en: An action which was in progress when another action interrupted it. We use the past continuous for the action in progress (longer action) and the past simple for the action that interrupted it (shorter action). She was having a bath when the phone rang.
tasks.uz: Boshqa ish uzganida davom etayotgan ish. Davom etayotgan (uzunroq) ish uchun o'tgan davomli, uzgan (qisqaroq) ish uchun o'tgan oddiy zamon. U cho'milayotganda telefon jiringladi.

tasks.en: An action in progress at a stated time in the past. James was sleeping at 9 o'clock last night.
tasks.uz: O'tmishdagi aniq vaqtda davom etayotgan ish. James kecha soat 9 da uxlayotgan edi.

tasks.en: Background information in a story. The wind was blowing when Jane left work last Friday.
tasks.uz: Hikoyada fon ma'lumoti. O'tgan juma Jane ishdan chiqqanda shamol esayotgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Adverbs usually describe verbs. He drives fast. Form: We usually form adverbs by adding -ly to the adjective. careful - carefully. When the adjective ends with a consonant + y, we drop -y and add -ily. lucky - luckily. Some adverbs have the same form as their adjectives: hard, fast, early. Note: good → well.
exercises.instructionUz: Ravishlar odatda fe'llarni tasvirlaydi. U tez haydaydi. Shakli: Ravishlarni odatda sifatga -ly qo'shib yasaymiz. careful - carefully. Sifat undosh + y bilan tugasa, -y ni tashlab -ily qo'shamiz. lucky - luckily. Ba'zi ravishlar sifati bilan bir xil shaklda: hard, fast, early. Eslatma: good → well.
exercises.explanationUz:
RAVIShLAR (ADVERBS).

  Ravish FE'LNI tasvirlaydi
  (qanday?):
  'He drives FAST.' = U tez
  haydaydi.

  ⚠ Sifat OTNI tasvirlaydi:
  'a fast car' (sifat)
  'drives fast' (ravish)


ShAKLI:

  1 SIFAT + -LY:
    careful → carefully
    slow → slowly, quick → quickly
  2 undosh + y → -ILY:
    lucky → luckily
    happy → happily, easy → easily
  3 BIR XIL ShAKL:
    hard → hard (qattiq)
    fast → fast (tez)
    early → early (erta)
    late → late (kech)
  4 NOTO'G'RI:
    good → WELL
    'He is a good driver. He drives
     WELL.'


⚠ 'HARDLY' ≠ 'HARD':

  hard = qattiq; hardly = deyarli
  yo'q. 'He works hard' ≠ 'He
  hardly works'!

exercises.explanationUz:
WILL - KELASI ODDIY ZAMON.

  WILL + FE'L (asosiy shakl) -
  HAMMA shaxsda bir xil!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: I will leave = I'll leave
    he will leave = he'll leave
  SO'ROQ: Will he leave?
  INKOR: he will not leave = he
    WON'T leave
  QISQA: Yes, I will. / No, I
    won't.

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
  'will go' ('will to go' EMAS).
  ⚠ Qisqa ijobiy javobda 'I'll'
  EMAS: 'Yes, I will.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 BAShORAT (fikr, ishonch
    asosida) - I think, I believe,
    I expect, probably bilan:
    'There WILL BE rain in Paris
     tomorrow.'
    'I think he'll win.'

  2 ShU ZAHOTI QAROR (on-the-spot):
    A: The phone is ringing.
    B: I'LL ANSWER it.


VAQT IBORALARI:
  tomorrow = ertaga
  soon = tez orada
  next week/month = kelasi hafta/oy
  the day after tomorrow = indinga


⚠ 'WON'T':

  = will not. /wəʊnt/.


⚠ 'A PREDICTION':

  = bashorat.


⚠ 'ON-THE-SPOT':

  = shu zahoti, o'sha joyda.

tasks.en: Will. Affirmative: I will (I'll) leave. Interrogative: Will I leave? Negative: I will not (won't) leave. Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb.
tasks.uz: Will. Tasdiq: I will (I'll) leave. So'roq: Will I leave? Inkor: I will not (won't) leave. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. Kelasi oddiy zamonni will va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.

tasks.en: We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb. He will go to the park. They will go to the beach.
tasks.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamonni will va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U bog'ga boradi. Ular plyajga boradi.

tasks.en: We form questions by putting will before the subject pronoun. Will he go to the park? We form negations by putting not after will. He will not/won't go to the park.
tasks.uz: Savollarni will ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. U bog'ga boradimi? Inkorni will dan keyin not qo'yib yasaymiz. U bog'ga bormaydi.

tasks.en: We use will to make predictions based on what we believe or think. We usually use will with I think, I believe, I expect, probably. There will be rain in Paris tomorrow.
tasks.uz: Will ni ishonch yoki fikrimiz asosida bashorat qilish uchun ishlatamiz. Odatda I think, I believe, I expect, probably bilan. Ertaga Parijda yomg'ir bo'ladi.

tasks.en: We use will to make on-the-spot decisions. A: The phone is ringing. B: I'll answer it.
tasks.uz: Will ni shu zahoti qaror qilish uchun ishlatamiz. A: Telefon jiringlayapti. B: Men javob beraman.

tasks.en: Time expressions used with the future simple: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc, the day after tomorrow etc.
tasks.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamon vaqt iboralari: ertaga, tez orada, kelasi hafta/oy, indinga.

exercises.instructionEn: Be going to - talking about plans and intentions. Affirmative: I am/You are/He is going to buy a car. Negative: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't going to buy a car. Interrogative: Am I/Are you/Is he going to buy a car? Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

exercises.explanationUz:
BE GOING TO - REJA va NIYaT.

  BE (am/is/are) + GOING TO + FE'L


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: He IS going to visit his
    friends.
  SO'ROQ: IS he going to visit his
    friends?
  INKOR: He ISN'T going to visit
    his friends.
  QISQA: Yes, he is. / No, he
    isn't.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 REJALAR va NIYaTLAR (oldindan
    qaror qilingan):
    'I AM GOING TO join a gym next
     week.'

  2 BAShORAT - KO'RGAN/BILGAN
    narsamiz asosida:
    'Look at the dark clouds! It'S
     GOING TO rain.'


⚠ WILL va BE GOING TO FARQI:

  WILL:
    - fikr asosida bashorat ('I
      think it will rain')
    - shu zahoti qaror ('I'll
      answer it')
  BE GOING TO:
    - oldindan reja ('I'm going to
      join a gym')
    - dalil asosida bashorat ('dark
      clouds - it's going to rain')


⚠ 'AN INTENTION':

  = niyat.


⚠ 'TO JOIN A GYM':

  = sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoq.

tasks.en: Be going to - talking about plans and intentions. Affirmative: I am/You are/He is going to buy a car. Negative: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't going to buy a car. Interrogative: Am I/Are you/Is he going to buy a car? Short answers: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
tasks.uz: Be going to - rejalar va niyatlar haqida. Tasdiq: I am/You are/He is going to buy a car. Inkor: I'm not/You aren't/He isn't going to buy a car. So'roq: Am I/Are you/Is he going to buy a car? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

tasks.en: We form the affirmative with the verb to be (is, am, are), going to and the base form of the verb. He is going to visit his friends.
tasks.uz: Tasdiqni 'to be' fe'li (is, am, are), going to va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi.

tasks.en: We form questions by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun. Is he going to visit his friends? We form negations by putting not after the verb to be. He is not/isn't going to visit his friends.
tasks.uz: Savollarni 'to be' fe'lini ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchimi? Inkorni 'to be' dan keyin not qo'yib yasaymiz. U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi emas.

tasks.en: We use be going to for plans and intentions. I am going to join a gym next week.
tasks.uz: Be going to ni rejalar va niyatlar uchun ishlatamiz. Kelasi hafta sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.

tasks.en: We use be going to for predictions based on what we see or we know. Look at the dark clouds! It's going to rain.
tasks.uz: Be going to ni ko'rgan yoki bilgan narsamiz asosida bashorat qilish uchun ishlatamiz. Qora bulutlarga qara! Yomg'ir yog'adi.

exercises.instructionEn: Present continuous for fixed arrangements: I am flying to Madrid tomorrow. Conditional 1: If + present simple, will + bare infinitive. If you don't eat, you will be hungry. When - If: When Tom comes, I'll cook dinner. (certain) If Tom comes, I'll cook dinner. (not certain)
exercises.instructionUz: Aniq rejalar uchun hozirgi davomli: Ertaga Madridga uchaman. 1-tur shart: If + hozirgi oddiy, will + 'to'siz infinitiv. Agar ovqatlanmasang, och qolasan. When - If: Tom kelganda kechki ovqat pishiraman. (aniq) Agar Tom kelsa, kechki ovqat pishiraman. (aniq emas)
exercises.explanationUz:
KELAJAK - UChTA USUL (5-unit):

  1 WILL - bashorat, shu zahoti
    qaror
  2 BE GOING TO - reja, dalilli
    bashorat
  3 PRESENT CONTINUOUS - ANIQ
    KELIShILGAN reja (fixed
    arrangement):
    'I AM FLYING to Madrid
     tomorrow.' (chipta olingan)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  1-TUR ShART GAPI                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF + PRESENT SIMPLE, WILL + FE'L

  REAL yoki JUDA EHTIMOLLI vaziyat
  (hozir yoki kelajakda):
  "If you DON'T EAT, you WILL BE
   hungry."
  "If I STUDY hard, I'LL DO well."

  ⚠ 'if' bo'lagida WILL YO'Q:
  'If it will rain' ✗ → 'If it
  rains' ✓


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHEN yoki IF?                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  WHEN = ANIQ bo'ladi (qachon?):
    'WHEN Tom comes, I'll cook.'
    (Tom albatta keladi)
  IF = ANIQ EMAS (agar):
    'IF Tom comes, I'll cook.'
    (kelishi noma'lum)


⚠ 'BARE INFINITIVE':

  = 'to'siz infinitiv.


⚠ 'PROBABLE':

  = ehtimolli.


⚠ 'CERTAIN':

  = aniq, ishonchli.

tasks.en: Present continuous for fixed arrangements: I am flying to Madrid tomorrow. Conditional 1: If + present simple, will + bare infinitive. If you don't eat, you will be hungry. When - If: When Tom comes, I'll cook dinner. (certain) If Tom comes, I'll cook dinner. (not certain)
tasks.uz: Aniq rejalar uchun hozirgi davomli: Ertaga Madridga uchaman. 1-tur shart: If + hozirgi oddiy, will + 'to'siz infinitiv. Agar ovqatlanmasang, och qolasan. When - If: Tom kelganda kechki ovqat pishiraman. (aniq) Agar Tom kelsa, kechki ovqat pishiraman. (aniq emas)

tasks.en: We can use the present continuous for actions we have already arranged to do in the near future (fixed arrangements). I am flying to Madrid tomorrow.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli zamonni yaqin kelajakda qilishga allaqachon kelishilgan ishlar uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin (aniq rejalar). Ertaga Madridga uchaman.

tasks.en: We use the first conditional to talk about real or very probable situations in the present or future. If + present simple, will + bare infinitive. If you don't eat, you will be hungry. If I study hard, I'll do well in the test.
tasks.uz: 1-tur shart gapini hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi real yoki juda ehtimolli vaziyatlar uchun ishlatamiz. If + hozirgi oddiy, will + 'to'siz infinitiv. Agar ovqatlanmasang, och qolasan. Agar qattiq o'qisam, testda yaxshi natija ko'rsataman.

tasks.en: We use when to show that something will certainly happen. When Tom comes, I'll cook dinner. We use if when we are not certain that something will happen. If Tom comes, I'll cook dinner.
tasks.uz: 'When' ni biror narsa albatta bo'lishini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz. Tom kelganda kechki ovqat pishiraman. 'If' ni biror narsa bo'lishiga ishonchimiz komil bo'lmaganda ishlatamiz. Agar Tom kelsa, kechki ovqat pishiraman.

exercises.explanationUz:
MIQDOR SO'ZLARI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME / ANY                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SOME - IJOBIY gapda (sanalmaydigan
  yoki ko'plik):
    'I want SOME milk and SOME
     biscuits.'
  SOME - TAKLIF va ILTIMOSDA:
    'Would you like SOME cake?'
    (taklif)
    'Can I have SOME water?'
    (iltimos)
  ANY - INKOR va SAVOLDA:
    "I haven't got ANY strawberries."
    'Have you got ANY oranges?'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MUCH / MANY                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Savol va inkorda:
  MANY + SANALADIGAN ko'plik:
    'Have you got MANY friends?'
    "I haven't got MANY friends."
  MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN:
    'Is there MUCH milk?'
    "There isn't MUCH tea left."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  A FEW / A LITTLE                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  A FEW (= bir nechta) + SANALADIGAN:
    'I want A FEW biscuits.'
  A LITTLE (= biroz) + SANALMAYDIGAN:
    'I want A LITTLE milk.'


⚠ SANALADIGAN / SANALMAYDIGAN:

  SANALADIGAN: biscuits, oranges,
  friends (ko'plik bor)
  SANALMAYDIGAN: milk, water, tea
  (ko'plik yo'q)


⚠ 'AN OFFER':

  = taklif.


⚠ 'A REQUEST':

  = iltimos.

tasks.en: Some/Any. Much/Many. A few/A little.
tasks.uz: Some/Any. Much/Many. A few/A little.

tasks.en: We use some in the affirmative with uncountable nouns or countable nouns in the plural. I want some milk and some biscuits. We also use some for offers or requests. Would you like some cake? Can I have some water, please?
tasks.uz: 'Some' ni tasdiqda sanalmaydigan otlar yoki ko'plik sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz. Men biroz sut va biroz pechenye xohlayman. 'Some' ni taklif yoki iltimoslarda ham ishlatamiz. Tort xohlaysizmi? Biroz suv olsam bo'ladimi?

tasks.en: We use any in negations and questions. I haven't got any strawberries. Have you got any oranges?
tasks.uz: 'Any' ni inkor va savollarda ishlatamiz. Menda qulupnay yo'q. Sizda apelsin bormi?

tasks.en: We use much and many in questions and negations. Many goes before plural countable nouns. Much goes before uncountable nouns. Is there much milk in the fridge? There isn't much tea left. Have you got many friends? I haven't got many friends.
tasks.uz: 'Much' va 'many' ni savol va inkorlarda ishlatamiz. 'Many' ko'plik sanaladigan otlardan oldin. 'Much' sanalmaydigan otlardan oldin. Muzlatgichda ko'p sut bormi? Ko'p choy qolmagan. Do'stlaringiz ko'pmi? Do'stlarim ko'p emas.

tasks.en: We use a few (= not many; some) with countable nouns. I want a few biscuits. We use a little (= not much; some) with uncountable nouns. I want a little milk.
tasks.uz: 'A few' (= ko'p emas; bir nechta) ni sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz. Bir nechta pechenye xohlayman. 'A little' (= ko'p emas; biroz) ni sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatamiz. Biroz sut xohlayman.
tasks.note: ⚠ a few - sanaladigan; a little - sanalmaydigan.

exercises.instructionEn: Giving advice. We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is. You should take regular exercise. We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do. You shouldn't throw rubbish in the street.
exercises.instructionUz: Maslahat berish. 'Should' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish nima ekanini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilishingiz kerak. 'Shouldn't' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish emasligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHAT - SHOULD.

  SHOULD + FE'L = ... kerak (yaxshi
  fikr)
    'You SHOULD take regular
     exercise.' (= It's a good idea.)
  SHOULDN'T + FE'L = ...masligi
    kerak (yomon fikr)
    "You SHOULDN'T throw rubbish in
     the street." (= It isn't a good
     idea.)

  ⚠ 'should' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q.
  ⚠ 'should' hamma shaxsda bir xil
  ('he should', 'he shoulds' ✗).


⚠ 'REGULAR EXERCISE':

  = muntazam jismoniy mashq.


⚠ 'TO THROW RUBBISH':

  = axlat tashlamoq.

tasks.en: Giving advice. We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is. You should take regular exercise. We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do. You shouldn't throw rubbish in the street.
tasks.uz: Maslahat berish. 'Should' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish nima ekanini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilishingiz kerak. 'Shouldn't' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish emasligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak.

tasks.en: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is. You should take regular exercise. (= It's a good idea.)
tasks.uz: 'Should' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish nima ekanini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Muntazam jismoniy mashq qilishingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr.)

tasks.en: We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do. You shouldn't throw rubbish in the street. (= It isn't a good idea.)
tasks.uz: 'Shouldn't' ni to'g'ri/eng yaxshi ish emasligini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Ko'chaga axlat tashlamasligingiz kerak. (= Bu yaxshi fikr emas.)

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect - Irregular Verb: I have (I've) bought, he has (he's) bought. Have I bought? I haven't bought. Form: have/has + past participle. Regular: watch - watched. Irregular: buy - bought.
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi tugallangan zamon - noto'g'ri fe'l: I have (I've) bought, he has (he's) bought. Have I bought? I haven't bought. Shakli: have/has + 3-shakl. To'g'ri: watch - watched. Noto'g'ri: buy - bought.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT - ShAKLI.

  HAVE / HAS + PAST PARTICIPLE
  (fe'lning 3-shakli)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  3-ShAKL (PAST PARTICIPLE)       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: -ED
    watch → watched
    work → worked
  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: alohida shakl
    buy → bought
    see → seen, go → gone, do → done
    (ro'yxat 128-betda)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NOTO'G'RI FE'L BILAN            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: I've bought, he's bought
  SO'ROQ: Has he washed the car?
    Have they travelled by plane?
  INKOR: He hasn't washed the car.
    They haven't travelled by
    plane.

  ⚠ 'not' - have/has va 3-shakl
  ORASIDA.


⚠ 'PAST PARTICIPLE':

  = o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi
  (fe'lning 3-shakli).

tasks.en: Present Perfect - Irregular Verb: I have (I've) bought, he has (he's) bought. Have I bought? I haven't bought. Form: have/has + past participle. Regular: watch - watched. Irregular: buy - bought.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan zamon - noto'g'ri fe'l: I have (I've) bought, he has (he's) bought. Have I bought? I haven't bought. Shakli: have/has + 3-shakl. To'g'ri: watch - watched. Noto'g'ri: buy - bought.

tasks.en: Irregular verb: I have bought (I've bought), he has bought (he's bought). Have I bought? Has he bought? I have not bought (I haven't bought), he has not bought (he hasn't bought).
tasks.uz: Noto'g'ri fe'l: I have bought (I've bought), he has bought (he's bought). Have I bought? Has he bought? I have not bought (I haven't bought), he has not bought (he hasn't bought).

tasks.en: We form the present perfect with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle of the main verb. We usually form the past participle of regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. watch - watched. Other verbs have irregular forms. buy - bought
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan zamonni yordamchi fe'l have/has va asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli bilan yasaymiz. To'g'ri fe'llarning 3-shaklini odatda -ed qo'shib yasaymiz. watch - watched. Boshqa fe'llar noto'g'ri shaklga ega. buy - bought

tasks.en: We form questions by putting have/has before the subject pronoun. Has he washed the car? Have they travelled by plane? We form negations by putting not between have/has and the past participle. He has not/hasn't washed the car. They have not/haven't travelled by plane.
tasks.uz: Savollarni have/has ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. U mashinani yuvdimi? Ular samolyotda sayohat qildimi? Inkorni have/has va 3-shakl orasiga not qo'yib yasaymiz. U mashinani yuvmagan. Ular samolyotda sayohat qilmagan.

exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT - IShLATILIShI:

  1 O'tmishda BOShLANIB HOZIRGAChA
    DAVOM etayotgan ish:
    'John HAS LIVED in Paris for
     the last three years.'
    (hali ham yashaydi)

  2 O'tmishdagi ish - HOZIR
    KO'RINADIGAN NATIJA:
    "I'VE BROKEN my arm." (I can't
    write - hozir yoza olmayman)

  3 TAJRIBA (umrda):
    'Have you EVER BEEN to Paris?'

  4 VAQTI NOMA'LUM o'tgan ish - ish
    vaqtdan muhimroq:
    "I'VE BEEN to New York three
     times so far."


⚠ PAST SIMPLE bilan FARQI:

  Present perfect - vaqt AYTILMAYDI
  yoki hozirgacha davom etadi.
  Past simple - ANIQ o'tgan vaqt
  (yesterday, in 1998).
  "I've been to Paris." (qachon -
  muhim emas)
  'I went to Paris last year.'
  (aniq vaqt)


⚠ 'BEEN TO' va 'GONE TO':

  has been to = borib KELGAN
  has gone to = ketgan (hali u
  yerda)


VAQT IBORALARI:
  just, already, yet, for, since,
  ever, never - keyingi qismlarda.


⚠ 'A VISIBLE RESULT':

  = ko'rinadigan natija.


⚠ 'UNSTATED':

  = aytilmagan.


⚠ 'SO FAR':

  = hozirgacha.

tasks.en: We use the present perfect to talk about an action which started in the past and continues to the present. John has lived in Paris for the last three years.

tasks.en: We also use the present perfect to talk about a past action with a visible result in the present. I've broken my arm. (I can't write).

tasks.en: We can also use the present perfect for an action which happened at an unstated time in the past. The action is more important than the time. I've been to New York three times so far.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan zamonni o'tmishda vaqti aytilmagan ish uchun ham ishlatishimiz mumkin. Ish vaqtdan muhimroq. Men hozirgacha Nyu-Yorkka uch marta borganman.

exercises.instructionEn: Ever/Never. Yet/Already. Just. For/Since.
exercises.instructionUz: Ever/Never. Yet/Already. Just. For/Since.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT BILAN KELADIGAN
SO'ZLAR:


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  EVER / NEVER                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  EVER = qachondir (savol va
  darakda):
    'Have you EVER visited Prague?'
    "Prague is the best city I've
     EVER visited."
  NEVER = hech qachon (darakda):
    "I've NEVER visited America."
    (= I haven't visited America.)
  ⚠ 'never' bilan inkor YO'Q:
  "I haven't never" ✗.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ALREADY / YET                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ALREADY = allaqachon (ijobiy va
  savolda), have/has dan KEYIN:
    'Have you done the washing-up
     ALREADY?'
    "I've ALREADY done it."
  YET = hali (savol va inkorda),
  GAP OXIRIDA:
    'Have you done the ironing YET?'
    "I haven't done the ironing
     YET."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  JUST                            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  JUST = hozirgina (bir necha
  daqiqa oldin tugagan):
    "I've JUST finished it."
  ⚠ have/has dan KEYIN.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FOR / SINCE                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  FOR + MUDDAT (qancha vaqt):
    "I've worked here FOR seven
     years."
    for two days, for a month, for
    a long time
  SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI
  (qachondan):
    "I've worked here SINCE 1992."
    since Monday, since 9 o'clock,
    since I was a child


⚠ 'THE WASHING-UP':

  = idish yuvish.


⚠ 'THE IRONING':

  = dazmollash.


⚠ 'DURATION':

  = davomiylik.


⚠ 'A STARTING POINT':

  = boshlanish nuqtasi.

tasks.en: Ever/Never. Yet/Already. Just. For/Since.
tasks.uz: Ever/Never. Yet/Already. Just. For/Since.

tasks.en: We use ever in questions and statements. Have you ever visited Prague? Prague is the best city I've ever visited. We use never in statements. I've never visited America. (= I haven't visited America.)
tasks.uz: 'Ever' ni savol va darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. Pragaga borganmisiz? Praga - men borgan eng yaxshi shahar. 'Never' ni darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. Men Amerikaga hech qachon bormaganman. (= Amerikaga bormaganman.)

tasks.en: We use already in positive statements and questions. Have you done the washing-up already? Yes, I have. I've already done it. We use yet in questions and negatives. Have you done the ironing yet? No, I haven't. I haven't done the ironing yet.
tasks.uz: 'Already' ni ijobiy darak va savollarda ishlatamiz. Idishlarni allaqachon yuvdingmi? Ha. Allaqachon yuvdim. 'Yet' ni savol va inkorlarda ishlatamiz. Dazmolni hali qildingmi? Yo'q. Dazmolni hali qilmadim.

tasks.en: We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier. Have you finished your homework yet? Yes, I've just finished it.
tasks.uz: 'Just' ni darak gaplarda ish bir necha daqiqa oldin tugaganini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz. Uy vazifangni hali tugatdingmi? Ha, hozirgina tugatdim.

tasks.en: We use for to express duration. I've worked here for seven years. We use since to state a starting point. I've worked here since 1992.
tasks.uz: 'For' ni davomiylikni bildirish uchun ishlatamiz. Men bu yerda yetti yildan beri ishlayman. 'Since' ni boshlanish nuqtasini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. Men bu yerda 1992 yildan beri ishlayman.

Short answers: Yes, I have. / No, he hasn't. Form: have/has + been + -ing. Use: an action which started in the past and continues to the present giving emphasis to duration; a past action which has lasted and whose result is visible in the present.
exercises.instructionUz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamon. Tasdiq: I've been reading, he's been reading. So'roq: Have I been reading? Has he been reading? Inkor: I haven't been reading. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I have. / No, he hasn't. Shakli: have/has + been + -ing. Ishlatilishi: o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan ish - davomiylikka urg'u; natijasi hozir ko'rinadigan davom etgan o'tgan ish.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS.

  HAVE / HAS + BEEN + FE'L-ING


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: I've been reading, he's
    been reading
  SO'ROQ: Have you been working
    here long?
  INKOR: They haven't been
    studying. She hasn't been
    living here long.
  QISQA: Yes, I have. / No, he
    hasn't.

  ⚠ 'not' - have/has va 'been'
  ORASIDA.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1 O'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha
    davom etayotgan ish -
    DAVOMIYLIKKA URG'U:
    'He HAS BEEN GOING to Jamaica
     since 1993.'
    'He has been watching TV FOR
     AN HOUR.'

  2 Davom etgan o'tgan ish -
    NATIJASI HOZIR KO'RINADI:
    "I'm tired because I'VE BEEN
     STUDYING for my exam."
    (charchoq - natija)


⚠ PRESENT PERFECT bilan FARQI:

  Present perfect - NATIJA/SON:
    "I've read three books."
  Present perfect continuous -
  JARAYoN/DAVOMIYLIK:
    "I've been reading all day."


⚠ 'EMPHASIS':

  = urg'u.


⚠ 'TO LAST':

  = davom etmoq.

tasks.en: Present Perfect Continuous. Affirmative: I've been reading, he's been reading. Interrogative: Have I been reading? Has he been reading? Negative: I haven't been reading. Short answers: Yes, I have. / No, he hasn't. Form: have/has + been + -ing. Use: an action which started in the past and continues to the present giving emphasis to duration; a past action which has lasted and whose result is visible in the present.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamon. Tasdiq: I've been reading, he's been reading. So'roq: Have I been reading? Has he been reading? Inkor: I haven't been reading. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I have. / No, he hasn't. Shakli: have/has + been + -ing. Ishlatilishi: o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan ish - davomiylikka urg'u; natijasi hozir ko'rinadigan davom etgan o'tgan ish.

tasks.en: We form the present perfect continuous with the auxiliary verb have/has, the past participle of the verb to be (been) and the main verb with the -ing form. He has been watching TV for an hour.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamonni yordamchi fe'l have/has, 'to be' fe'lining 3-shakli (been) va asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan yasaymiz. U bir soatdan beri televizor ko'rmoqda.

tasks.en: We form questions by putting have/has before the subject. Have you been working here long? We form negations by putting not between have/has and been. They have not/haven't been studying for a long time. She has not/hasn't been living here long.
tasks.uz: Savollarni have/has ni egadan oldin qo'yib yasaymiz. Bu yerda uzoqdan beri ishlayapsizmi? Inkorni have/has va been orasiga not qo'yib yasaymiz. Ular uzoq vaqtdan beri o'qimayapti. U bu yerda uzoqdan beri yashamayapti.

tasks.en: We use the present perfect continuous to talk about an action which started in the past and continues to the present giving emphasis to duration. He has been going to Jamaica for his holidays since 1993.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamonni o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan ish haqida davomiylikka urg'u berib gapirish uchun ishlatamiz. U 1993 yildan beri ta'tilga Yamaykaga bormoqda.

tasks.en: We also use the present perfect continuous to talk about a past action which has lasted and whose result is visible in the present. I'm tired because I've been studying for my exam.
tasks.uz: Hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamonni natijasi hozir ko'rinadigan davom etgan o'tgan ish haqida gapirish uchun ham ishlatamiz. Charchadim, chunki imtihonga tayyorlanayotgan edim.

exercises.instructionEn: Past Perfect Simple. Affirmative: I had started. Interrogative: Had I started? Negative: I hadn't started. Short answers: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't. Form: had + past participle. Use: a past action which happened before another past action. He watched TV after he had finished his homework.
exercises.instructionUz: O'tgan tugallangan zamon. Tasdiq: I had started. So'roq: Had I started? Inkor: I hadn't started. Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I had. / No, I hadn't. Shakli: had + 3-shakl. Ishlatilishi: boshqa o'tgan ishdan oldin bo'lgan o'tgan ish. U uy vazifasini tugatgandan keyin televizor ko'rdi.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT - O'TMIShDAN OLDINGI
O'TMISh.

  HAD + FE'LNING 3-ShAKLI
  (HAMMA shaxsda bir xil!)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ: I had started = I'd
    started; he had started
  SO'ROQ: Had he started?
  INKOR: He hadn't started.
  QISQA: Yes, I had. / No, I
    hadn't.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  IShLATILIShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  O'tmishdagi IKKI ish - qaysi
  OLDIN bo'lgan:
  'He WATCHED TV after he HAD
   FINISHED his homework.'
  1-ish (oldin): had finished
  2-ish (keyin): watched

  ⚠ 'after', 'before', 'when',
  'by the time' bilan ko'p keladi.


⚠ KO'ChIRMA GAPDA:

  Past simple → past perfect:
  'She left' → 'He said she HAD
  LEFT.' (14-unit)


⚠ "I'D":

  = I had (past perfect) yoki I
  would - kontekstga qarang:
  "I'd finished" (had),
  "I'd like" (would).
